transcript.text: Good morning. I'm Maj. Okafor, the Signal Officer. I'll be signing off on the equipment allocation and operating plan for tomorrow's portable power module assignments. Before I finalize anything, I need to hear from supply and operations on any updates that might affect how we assign PB-1, PB-2, and PB-3 to the communications shelter, cold-storage point, and maintenance tent. Who's ready to report?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag an important update from supply. This morning I confirmed that PB-2 is the only module with the certified adapter for the cold-storage controller. The adapter check is recorded on the receiving worksheet, but it hasn't been entered on the equipment allocation sheet yet. This means PB-2 must be assigned to the cold-storage point, not the communications shelter or maintenance tent.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to pass on a critical update that came in after the morning briefing. I received a higher-headquarters tasking message requiring the communications shelter to use PB-1 continuously from 1300 to 1700 for the scheduled network-maintenance period. This message has not yet been posted to the daily operations board, so no one else has seen it. This directly impacts our allocation: PB-1 is locked in for the communications shelter during that window, and combined with Lt. Marin's update that PB-2 must go to the cold-storage point, that leaves PB-3 for the maintenance tent.
transcript.speaker: A3

Post the higher-headquarters tasking message requiring PB-1 at the communications shelter from 1300 to 1700 to the daily operations board.
Confirm PB-2 is assigned to the cold-storage point and ensure it is available before scheduled cold-storage work begins.
Confirm PB-3 is assigned to the maintenance tent and ensure it is available before scheduled maintenance work begins.
